scientific_scope: Read-only secondary analysis of frozen E1 exact 50,000-flow class-block outputs. No learner execution, raw-dataset read, retuning, seed change, feature change, or model-state change.
unit_of_analysis: attack-class x exact non-overlapping 50,000-flow block after seed averaging within learner
seed_aggregation: Arithmetic mean of class-block recall across the five fixed seeds for OB/MOOB/MUOB; HT uses its single deterministic run. Support uses the invariant maximum within the grouped records.

primary_estimands.name: within_class_support_recall_slope
primary_estimands.definition: Class-fixed-effect slope of recall on log10(class support), estimated separately by dataset and learner. The coefficient is absolute recall change associated with a 10-fold within-class increase in support.
primary_estimands.interpretation: Association only; not causal. Positive slope means recall tends to be higher when the same class has greater support.

primary_estimands.name: within_class_minority_state_recall_contrast
primary_estimands.definition: Class-fixed-effect coefficient for dynamic-minority state (minority minus active non-minority recall), restricted to attack classes observed in both states at the chosen support floor.
primary_estimands.interpretation: Association only; not causal. Negative contrast means the same switching classes tend to have lower recall while dynamically minority.

degenerate_model_policy: MUOB is reported descriptively. If attack-class recall is constant, no relationship p-value or Holm test is assigned.
temporal_inference: Moving-block bootstrap over the full chronological sequence of exact analysis-block indices; all eligible class rows within a sampled temporal block move together. Percentile 95% intervals and centered-null bootstrap p-values are reported.

multiplicity.primary_relationship_family: Holm within each dataset over 6 tests: 3 inferential learners x 2 primary relationship estimands at support floor 50 and L=20.
multiplicity.secondary_treatment_contrast_family: Holm within each dataset over 4 synchronized-bootstrap contrasts: OB-HT and MOOB-HT for each of the two primary relationship estimands at support floor 50 and L=20.

claim_boundaries: Do not claim that dynamic imbalance causes recall degradation.
Do not call prevalence/minority-state changes concept drift.
Do not treat seeds as independent streams.
Do not use overlapping rolling windows for this formal relationship inference.
Do not reinterpret a non-significant association as evidence of no operational vulnerability.
Do not change the analysis protocol after inspecting the relationship outputs except to correct a demonstrated implementation defect, which must be versioned and documented.
